intro.text: A Reshi trademaster and son of the king of the island Relu-na.

items.text: Sent to Thaylenah as a child to train under Vstim, Talik became a trademaster and returned to Relu-na to interpret for the king and trade with outsiders.
Talik and Vstim staged a tough, high-stakes trade as practice for Vstim's apprentice, Rysn. It went wrong when Rysn, desperate to complete it, jumped from the island and was paralysed in the fall.
Before Rysn set out, Talik met her in her office in Thaylenah and advised her to take her ailing larkin, Chiri-Chiri, to the lost city of Akinah in Aimia.
